BiblicalUsage: Parashah is an exact statement, a declaration, a copy set out plainly. Mordecai gives Hathach the exact sum of the money Haman promised in Esther 4:7, and Esther 10:2 points to the book of the chronicles for the full declaration of Mordecai's greatness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe an exact statement matters when lives are at stake, and Mordecai's careful accounting is part of how God worked through him.
